rules.rationale: Concrete recursive equation defining factRun for the I <= N step; it advances the index and multiplies the accumulator without matching operational configuration cells.
Concrete base equation defining factRun when I > N by returning the accumulated product.

Reverse-step equality used to fold factRun during symbolic proof; Stage 1 does not first prove this exact rule in a module that omits it, so it is an additional trusted mathematical fact rather than a proved derived lemma.
Simplification-form duplicate of the factRun base equation under the same I > N guard, so it is definitional normalization rather than an additional fact.
Concrete recursive equation defining totalRun for the I <= N step by advancing the index and adding I to the accumulator.
Concrete base equation defining totalRun when I > N by returning the accumulated sum.
Reverse-step equality used to fold totalRun during symbolic proof; it is present in the compiled proof definition and has no prior exact proof against a module without the rule.
Simplification-form duplicate of the totalRun base equation under the identical I > N guard.
Concrete even-index recurrence defining resultRun by appending F*I and advancing all three loop accumulators.
Concrete odd-index recurrence defining resultRun by appending T+I and advancing the index, product, and sum accumulators.
Concrete base equation defining resultRun when I > N by returning the accumulated value sequence.
Even-case reverse-step equality that folds an advanced resultRun term; Stage 1 assumes it in verification.k before proving the targets and supplies no earlier exact proof without it.
Odd-case reverse-step equality that folds an advanced resultRun term; it is a proof-closing mathematical fact not separately established by the mounted Stage 1 proof.
Simplification-form duplicate of the resultRun base equation under the same I > N guard.
